verses.text: For the one directing. Of the sons of Korah a Psalm. You have shown favor, O YHWH, [to] Your land; You have turned back the captivity of Jacob.

segments.text: For the one directing. Of the sons of Korah a Psalm. You have shown favor, O YHWH, [to] Your land; You have turned back the captivity of Jacob.

verses.text: You have borne away the iniquity of Your people; You have covered all their sin. Selah

segments.text: You have borne away the iniquity of Your people; You have covered all their sin. Selah

verses.text: You have gathered up all Your fury; You have turned from the burning of Your anger.

segments.text: You have gathered up all Your fury; You have turned from the burning of Your anger.

verses.text: Restore us, O God of our salvation, and Your anger toward us cause to cease!

segments.text: Restore us, O God of our salvation, and Your anger toward us cause to cease!

verses.text: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to generation and generation?

segments.text: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to generation and generation?

verses.text: Will You not turn back [and] revive us, that Your people may rejoice in You?

segments.text: Will You not turn back [and] revive us, that Your people may rejoice in You?

verses.text: Show us, O YHWH, Your loving devotion, and give to us Your salvation!

segments.text: Show us, O YHWH, Your loving devotion, and give to us Your salvation!

verses.text: Let me hear what [my] God YHWH will speak, for He will speak peace to His people and to His holy ones; He will not let them return to folly.

segments.text: Let me hear what [my] God YHWH will speak, for He will speak peace to His people and to His holy ones; He will not let them return to folly.

verses.text: Surely His salvation [is] near to those fearing Him, that glory may dwell in our land.

segments.text: Surely His salvation [is] near to those fearing Him, that glory may dwell in our land.

verses.text: Loving devotion and faithfulness have met together; righteousness and peace have kissed.

segments.text: Loving devotion and faithfulness have met together; righteousness and peace have kissed.

verses.text: Faithfulness springs forth from the earth, and righteousness looks down from the heavens.

segments.text: Faithfulness springs forth from the earth, and righteousness looks down from the heavens.

verses.text: Indeed YHWH will give that which is good, and our land will give forth its produce.

segments.text: Indeed YHWH will give that which is good, and our land will give forth its produce.

verses.text: Righteousness will go before Him, to prepare the way of His steps.

segments.text: Righteousness will go before Him, to prepare the way of His steps.
